Minecraft Dungeons II is out now on XBOX Series X|S and Windows! 

Step through the rift and fight where no hero has been before: the Sift, an uncharted dimension teeming with threats, mysteries, and breathtaking beauty. Gear up and customize your gameplay to face your toughest enemies yet in explosive battles. Brave the unknown as a lone hero, team up with friends in couch, online and mixed co-op, or find allies through matchmaking. The illagers’ plot is already underway, and their cruelty is only matched by their power. Stop them – or lose the Overworld to their corruption. 

Get Minecraft Dungeons II: Deluxe Edition for more battles, more customization, and more cuteness. Includes 4 additional hero skins, the Soul cape, the Blub pet, and DLC 1 & 2.*

description:
Japan Has Arrived!

Discover one of Japan’s most beautiful railway journeys in Train Sim World 7: Tadami Line: Aizu-Wakamatsu - Tadami.

Travel through breathtaking rural Japan aboard the iconic KiHa 40, passing cherry blossoms, winding rivers, mountain valleys and spectacular bridges high above the landscape.

https://www.xbox.com/games/store/train-sim-world-7-tadami-line-aizu-wakamatsu-tadami/9njp4gwfz6wz

Whether you’re a lifelong rail fan or simply love the idea of exploring stunning places by train, Tadami Line offers a relaxing and immersive way to experience a real Japanese railway brought to life with authentic trains, detailed stations and realistic operations.

Explore 88 km of railway, stop at 28 stations and experience Train Sim World’s first Japanese route.
